'''Jiree''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. He worked for [[Eelien Kirat]] and the [[Nalmar Family|Nalmar crime family]] as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]]. Jiree would often accompany [[Elana Nalmar]] on undercover missions.
